channelTitle: 3 things in your fridge Grandma June uses for tired eyes
hook: Puffy tired eyes after a long day? Grandma June opens the fridge, not a jar.
remedy: A classic home beauty ritual: chilled cucumber slices rested over closed eyes. It is the old-fashioned way generations used to refresh tired, puffy eyes.
steps: Slice a cold cucumber into thick rounds
Lie down and rest them over closed eyes for 10 minutes
Pat the skin dry - no rubbing the delicate eye area
cta: Cucumber, tea bags, or something else - what does your family use? Comment below
